title: The Early-Woken Thread Primer
summary: A primer for the rare mortal whose soul stirs before the Xiantian realm that teaches the first fine threads of soul force and how to guard a fragile soul.

title: The Soul-Thread Primer
summary: A primer on laying fine threads of soul force across empty air and reading the tremor when another soul touches them.

title: A Handbook of the Waiting Knot
summary: A handbook on knots of soul force that lie still until a soul crosses them and then draw closed.

title: The Plain Snare-Work Drill-Book
summary: A drill-book of the plainest snares of soul force with the daily drills that make their laying steady and quiet.

title: Workbook of the Quiet Latch
summary: A workbook on latches that close without sound and on the soft pressures that make a held soul give way.

title: The Soul-Gin Handbook
summary: A handbook that carries the plain knots on to toothed gins and the first tensions that spring them.
